# Ask HR Agent — Delivery Runbook

## Prerequisites

| Recipe prerequisite | Recorded requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Copilot Studio plugin | mcs-assistant@copilot-studio-plugin |
| Minimum PAC CLI version | 2.9.3 |
| Authoring mode | cli-copilot |
| Portable tool to verify | AskHRAgent |
| Build workload | 22 captured manual build steps · 6 skills · 2 knowledge files · 5 acceptance checks · 6 locked cases |

### Delivery prerequisites

| Requirement | Confirm before building |
| --- | --- |
| Licensing and capacity | Confirm licensing for your tenant and Copilot Credits for the GitHub Copilot harness. Building, Preview and evaluation consume credits before publication; obtain administrator approval. |
| Environment and maker access | Record the approved Ask HR environment, publisher prefix and maker access. Confirm the reviewed Sonnet46 model is available; keep the workshop synthetic and Draft. |
| DLP and data policy | Have the administrator review policies for uploaded HR documents, proposed production sources and the intended channel. Document blocked paths; do not bypass them to complete the demo. |
| Identity and audience | Review the supplied GroupMembership access policy, Integrated authentication and Always authentication trigger. Record who may build, test and later use Ask HR. |
| Connection ownership | Name owners for proposed HRIS, benefits and policy connections, with approved identities and least-privilege references. No customer connection is needed for the synthetic workshop. |
| Test identities | Prepare employee, manager, HR-reviewer and denied-access identities for an approved test deployment. Makers use Draft Preview; do not publish the workshop just to enable sharing. |
| Tooling by build lane | Manual lane: Copilot Studio browser and reviewed files. Easy mode: VS Code Agent mode, the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin and PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer. |
| Policy and decision ownership | Have the HR owner identify authoritative policy and benefits sources and the approved route for personal determinations. Keep real employee records out of workshop knowledge and public evidence. |

### Delivery roles

| Role | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| HR business owner | Approve the policy sources, employee-facing scope and escalation workflow; agree production success measures without treating fictional balances as customer results. |
| Authorized HR and benefits reviewers | Verify eligibility, exceptions and plan rules through the approved HR workflow; retain decisions that the policy-explanation and draft skills must not make. |
| Copilot Studio maker | Build the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and six skills; remove web search, preserve model parity and record the owned agent's Draft state. |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing and capacity, maker access, authenticated audience and data policies before approving any HR production connection. |
| HR source and connection owners | Approve HRIS, benefits and policy access; record each connection identity and least-privilege reference, and resolve access failures before a production test. |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check HR-01 through HR-06, the refusal tests and Easy/Manual parity; reject missing citations, incomplete inventory captures and Draft badges belonging to other agents. |
| Operations owner | Own production support, session and credit monitoring, and configuration recovery; send individualized HR determinations to the authorized reviewers. |

### Connections to qualify, not assumed live

- Use only approved, least-privilege production connections; the packaged demonstration uses synthetic knowledge files.

## Phase 1 — Easy Mode with GitHub Copilot

From [EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md):

### 1. Attach the Copilot-only skill

Download [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md), open GitHub
Copilot Chat in VS Code, select **Agent mode**, and drag `SKILL.md` into the
chat.

The attached skill carries the discovery, testing, deployment, and validation
harness directly in GitHub Copilot, so the attendee still uses the same short
messages instead of supplying URLs or mechanics. Before deployment it installs
and verifies the official `microsoft/copilot-studio-plugin`, its
`mcs-assistant@copilot-studio-plugin` capabilities, and a supported PAC CLI.

Then send these two short messages:

### 2. Build and test the solution

```text
Give me Ask HR using Easy Mode and test it for me.
```

### 3. Deploy the validated Draft

```text
Deploy it into Copilot Studio for me.
```

### Completion boundary

Copilot may perform setup, local validation, source-controlled Copilot Studio
authoring, and evidence checks. It must stop at **Draft**. Publishing and every
production write remain separate human approval gates.

### Source-controlled lane checklist (catalog easy_mode)

This catalog checklist describes source-controlled delivery, including future connection work. The package's synthetic-data and Draft-only boundaries still apply.

- [ ] Verify Power Platform CLI 2.9.3 or newer and authenticate to the approved target environment.
- [ ] Initialize a modern cli-copilot project with an approved publisher prefix and preserve the generated identity settings.
- [ ] Upload the two packaged synthetic knowledge files and every operation-specific SKILL.md.
- [ ] Bind only approved least-privilege production connections after security, privacy, and business-owner review.
- [ ] Push the Draft agent, replay every locked persona case, and stop before publish for explicit approval.

### Recipe-specific authoring prompt

Catalog reference for the source-controlled lane; retain the Draft-only completion boundary above.

```text
Using the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin, initialize a Draft agent for Ask HR Agent from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/solutions/ask-hr/deployment.json. Upload the two synthetic knowledge files and 6 skills, replay every locked case, and Stop before publish. Do not bind production connections without explicit customer approval.
```

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] The maker has authenticated to the approved environment and preserved the initialized cli-copilot identity and settings.
- [ ] The pushed Draft contains the reviewed HR instructions, two synthetic knowledge files and six skills, with the reviewed model and no live customer connections.
- [ ] HR-01 through HR-06 pass the final-response marker checks in target Preview; a successful push alone is not acceptance.
- [ ] The reviewer has recorded agent identity, environment, model, inventory, case results and `published: false`; publication remains a separate decision.

## Phase 2 — Optional Brainstem Track

From [EASY-MODE-PERSONLESS.md](../../solutions/ask-hr/EASY-MODE-PERSONLESS.md):

### 1. Attach the Brainstem skill

Download [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/skills/aibast-easy-mode-brainstem/SKILL.md), open GitHub
Copilot Chat in VS Code, select **Agent mode**, and drag `SKILL.md` into the
chat. This skill fixes the lane to Brainstem and owns startup, agent
acquisition, testing, deployment, browser validation, and the final verdict.

Brainstem is the learner's personal, on-device training AI. It works alongside
Copilot, remembers the workshop, and hot-loads specialized instructors while
Copilot remains the familiar work surface.

Then send these two short messages:

### 2. Build and test the solution

```text
Give me Ask HR using Easy Mode and test it for me.
```

### 3. Deploy the validated Draft

```text
Deploy it into Copilot Studio for me.
```

### What pulls the harness

1. The attached skill starts the installed Brainstem, finds
   `@aibast-agents-library/workshop` in the AIBAST registry, and imports it
   through `/agents/import`.
2. `AIBASTWorkshopAgent` resolves the named solution from `registry.json`,
   retrieves its standard package, and hot-loads and tests the business agent.
3. The same generic engine remembers the active solution, so “Deploy it” runs
   the validated Draft flow without the attendee repeating URLs or context.
4. Copilot executes any real front-door handoff returned by Brainstem, sends
   the captured Preview evidence back, and continues until Brainstem returns
   `status: complete`.
5. The final gate requires **Draft** and `published: false`.

Generic workshop engine: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/agents/@aibast-agents-library/templates/workshop_agent.py

The person sets the destination and reads the
verdict; Brainstem + Copilot pull the harness.

## Phase 4 — Acceptance

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** expected names, identifiers, and figures below are fictional test evidence, not customer results.

- [ ] Every exposed operation has one persona-language case and one SKILL.md.
- [ ] Exactly two synthetic knowledge files are present.
- [ ] Responses state the relevant human approval or review boundary.
- [ ] No operation claims an external write, communication, commitment, or protected decision.
- [ ] Publishing remains a separate user-approved step.

### Deployment smoke test

| Check | Expected value |
| --- | --- |
| Prompt | What does my fictional leave snapshot show, and what notice rules should I review? |
| Must call | AskHRAgent |
| Must include | 15.5 days; Upcoming Company Holidays |
| Arguments | Operation: leave_balance; Employee name: Jordan Chen |

### Package evidence gates

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Evidence gates](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#evidence-gates):

- **Source gate:** deployment source and isolated transcripts exist.
- **Easy gate:** available Easy evidence identifies the agent, environment,
  model, inventory, cases, and Draft state.
- **Manual gate:** manual evidence passes, every browserfilm frame exists, and
  the tutorial maps one action to each frame.
- **Parity gate:** Easy and Manual use the reviewed instructions, knowledge,
  skills, model, and case identifiers.
- **Draft gate:** the package records `published: false`; publication is not
  part of scaffolding.
- **Customer gate:** replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support,
  and success measures are agreed before production.

### Go / no-go

| Criterion | Required threshold |
| --- | --- |
| Locked HR corpus | Go only when all six cases, HR-01 through HR-06, satisfy every must_include and must_not_include assertion. A missing marker is a failure, not a near pass. |
| Source and transcript evidence | Deployment source and exact isolated-run transcripts must exist; static demos must use those transcripts, and Copilot Studio must replay the same corpus. Missing evidence is no-go. |
| Inventory and build parity | Require the reviewed instructions, two knowledge files, six skills, matching model, removed web search and no tools in the workshop. Stop if Easy and Manual differ. |
| Time-off draft boundary | HR-02 must preserve `Not Submitted`, `Draft for employee review` and `No notification was sent`. A submission, notification or claim of one is no-go. |
| Privacy and human authority | Every boundary test must avoid sensitive inference, eligibility decisions, plan recommendations and external actions. Any breach blocks acceptance even if the six locked cases pass. |
| Visual checkpoint acceptance | A checkpoint needs its visible target-state anchor and no defeating blocker. Withhold reshoot-required images; incomplete save, skill and Draft proof cannot pass that step. |
| Release state | The reviewed target agent remains Draft with `published: false`. Another agent's Draft badge, an import, or a Preview pass is not authorization to publish. |
| Production decision | No-go until replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures are agreed and human authorization is defined. Workshop acceptance is not production approval. |

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] The acceptance reviewer has recorded all six locked case results against their exact assertions and the canonical transcript corpus.
- [ ] The refusal and escalation tests preserve privacy, human decisions and the no-action boundary; any violation blocks acceptance.
- [ ] Easy and Manual instructions, knowledge, skills and model match; required evidence exists, and reusable captures are distinguished from incomplete or reshoot-required proof.
- [ ] The acceptance record identifies the owned Draft agent and `published: false`; it does not claim live HR integration, customer outcomes or publication approval.

## Phase 5 — Production Hardening

| Area | Owner and action |
| --- | --- |
| Identity and audience | Administrator: scope authenticated HR access and test allowed and denied identities in a separately approved test deployment. Do not publish the workshop to make sharing available. |
| DLP and data handling | Administrator and HR owner: approve document sources, tool and channel policies; verify blocked paths stay blocked and keep real employee details out of public evidence. |
| ALM | Maker: retain reviewed HR source and sync metadata, pull before editing and pushing, and package with `pac copilot pack`. Replay the six-case corpus before separate publication approval. |
| Telemetry and support | After approved release, the operator reviews Monitor sessions, reactions, tool errors and credits; send policy defects to HR and restrict access to employee-bearing transcripts. |
| Rollback | Operator: reapply retained, known-good HR files in a test workspace, pull before push and replay six cases plus boundary tests; obtain separate approval before restoring production access. |
| Connection ownership | HR source owners: record the owner, identity, reference and permitted operations for each approved HRIS, benefits or policy connection; resolve authentication failures before retesting. |
| Human authorization | HR and security owners: keep individualized decisions in the approved HR workflow. Any future write needs separate authorization and tool-result evidence; the workshop remains read-only. |

### Production replacement seams

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Production replacement seams](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#production-replacement-seams):

- Replace packaged synthetic inputs with an approved Bind only customer-approved systems after security, privacy, and business-owner review connection; preserve the reviewed input and output contract.

The pilot must never claim a side effect, live lookup, or system update unless
an approved production tool returns evidence that it succeeded.

Review the [architecture seams](2.Architecture.md#production-replacement-seams) and the [customer gate](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#evidence-gates) before changing data sources or enabling writes; workshop acceptance is not production approval.

**Exit criteria**

- [ ] HR, privacy and security owners have approved replacement sources, least-privilege connections and the human authorization workflow before any proposed production action.
- [ ] Authenticated audience and source-permission tests pass in a separately approved test deployment, including denied-access users; the workshop remains Draft.
- [ ] The operations owner has agreed telemetry, support and success measures and recorded a known-good configuration recovery exercise.
- [ ] The six-case synthetic regression pack and boundary tests pass after configuration changes; a separate reviewer approves any production publication.

## Failure Recovery

From [FIELD-GUIDE.md — Failure recovery](../../solutions/ask-hr/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery):

| Symptom | Recovery |
| --- | --- |
| A required evidence file is missing | Stop. Capture or restore the real file; never substitute a mockup. |
| A browser frame disagrees with the tutorial | Treat the frame and evidence JSON as authoritative, correct the package metadata, and regenerate. |
| Knowledge is still processing | Wait for ingestion to finish before Preview; do not interpret a partial answer as evidence. |
| A skill upload fails | Download the linked raw `SKILL.md`, correct the reviewed source if necessary, and retry visibly. |
| Easy and Manual inventories differ | Stop the comparison and restore exact instruction, knowledge, skill, and model parity. |
| A recorded identifier is absent | Mark the case failed and investigate; do not retry until it happens to pass. |
| Publish is offered | Stop at Draft unless a separate approver explicitly authorizes publication. |

## Deliverables Checklist

- [ ] Every advertised one-pager capability maps to implemented behavior.
- [ ] The synthetic data contains the customer problem the slide describes.
- [ ] Persona-language prompts route to the agent in an isolated Brainstem.
- [ ] The deterministic output proves the expected entities and decisions.
- [ ] Canonical transcripts are captured from those exact live runs.
- [ ] Static demos render the captured transcripts rather than invented replies.
- [ ] Copilot Studio replays the same corpus before publishing.

Source: [seven-step release gate](../../solutions/README.md#release-gate). Record fresh evidence against each check; this list is not a claim that the checks passed.
